retention_by_class.why: a measurement must remain auditable for longer than the analysis that uses it, and a year plus a margin is the smallest span that survives an annual re-reading. Chosen by the project, not derived from anything.
nothing is stored, so nothing is retained
logs exist to debug a run, and a run is bounded in days rather than months
